svg.text: RQ4 — Does the value head change the benefit of MCTS inference?
Validation-led primary analysis only. Effects are paired by seed; lines are 95% t-intervals; pH is Holm-adjusted within each stage/cutoff family.
Cross-cell level: VH-on MCTS - parallel VH-off policy
VH interaction: VH-on MCTS benefit - VH-off MCTS benefit
Left: lower coverage. Right: higher coverage. * Holm-adjusted p < .05.
